contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]TINIAN VS PF AVG ; R/ GLORIA RO [MANORVM]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right issue of 364-375, possibly Arles mint. Both design and condition are atypically good for a Valentiniac issue. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TINIAN VS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing left holding labarum and dragging captive; the figures unusually animated…
